issues.message: 26 fence/pane/wall block(s) have no north/east/south/west set although a neighbour would connect, so they show as lone posts: (0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (2, 0, 0) and 23 more.

notes.roof: half-slab steps, almost flat, one spruce colour

visual.summary: Pens and stables level 1: reads as a stable with a pen, but the fences are lone posts (your note) and the roof is a flat stack of spruce slabs.
problems: Join every fence: Carlton's note on all three levels is "Fences are broken"; the pen ring, side rails and stall divider show as lone posts (26 blocks).
Replace the shallow one-colour slab roof with a steep stair gable (dark oak eaves, spruce slopes, dark ridge) with plank gable ends.
Make the levels differ visibly: give level 3 its own life (leaf bushes at the posts, a lantern on the gable, flower boxes on the back wall), without moving level 2 or 3 extras into level 1.

visual.summary: Pens and stables level 1: fences now join and the steep dark-eaved gable roof looks right; the pen is still empty, which is fine for the first level.
problems: The pen is bare at this level: a water trough or a hay bale would make it read as a working stable sooner.
Side walls of the stable are open; a half-height plank wall between the side posts would add depth.

visual.summary: The stable with its steep dark roof, stalls and a feed trough, and now the paddock gateway Carlton asked for: two dark log gateposts and a lintel over an open gap soldiers can walk through.
problems: No plants yet at this level; a bush by the corner would help
The gateway lintel is heavy for its size: a slab or stair top would look lighter

visual.summary: The stable with its steep dark roof, stalls and a feed trough, and now the paddock gateway Carlton asked for: two dark log gateposts and a lintel over an open gap soldiers can walk through. Now sits with its floor level with the grass.
problems: No plants yet at this level; a bush by the corner would help
The gateway lintel is heavy for its size: a slab or stair top would look lighter
The stable floor is now flush with the grass (meta.groundLayer 0): the builders never dig or replace ground, so the mod has to support this before it can be built as drawn
